description: The bar of a pushed screen (DESIGN.md, ScreenBar): at least TsuyaSize.bar tall; a round back button named backLabel at the start (required together with onBack); title centred in TsuyaType.titleM, one line with an ellipsis, an optional subtitle caption below it; at most one action at the end.

constructors.description: A bar headed title, with subtitle, onBack (named backLabel) and action.

params.name: title
params.description: The bar's title, centred on one line.

params.name: subtitle
params.description: A caption line under the title.

params.name: onBack
params.description: Called when the back button is pressed; without it, there is no back button.

params.name: backLabel
params.description: The back button's accessible name; required together with onBack.
